title: Learning Perturbation Robust Policies for LLM Agents with Stable Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.34064v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become an effective post-training paradigm for long-horizon large language model (LLM) agents. However, we find that the resulting policies can be sensitive to various policy perturbations, such as hidden-state noise, pruning, and quantization. In this work, we study how to improve perturbation robustness during policy optimization. We first introduce the notion of a perturbation robust policy and analyze conditions under which perturbed policy updates preserve stable monotonic improvement. Based on this analysis, we introduce Stable Perturbation-Robust Policy Optimization (SPrPO), which applies adaptive and sensitivity-aware perturbations during RL training. We evaluate SPrPO on ALFWorld and WebShop and conduct systematic experiments across multiple perturbation types and scales, showing improved perturbation robustness while maintaining stable policy optimization.

translated_title: 通过稳定优化学习面向大语言模型智能体的扰动鲁棒策略
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）已成为长时程大语言模型（LLM）智能体的一种有效的后训练范式。然而，我们发现由此得到的策略可能对各种策略扰动十分敏感，例如隐藏状态噪声、剪枝和量化。在本工作中，我们研究如何在策略优化过程中提升扰动鲁棒性。我们首先引入了扰动鲁棒策略的概念，并分析了受扰动的策略更新在何种条件下能够保持稳定的单调改进。基于这一分析，我们提出了稳定扰动鲁棒策略优化（SPrPO），它在强化学习训练过程中施加自适应且感知敏感度的扰动。我们在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上评估了 SPrPO，并针对多种扰动类型和扰动规模开展了系统性实验，结果表明该方法在提升扰动鲁棒性的同时保持了稳定的策略优化。
tldr: 提出稳定扰动鲁棒策略优化方法 SPrPO，通过在强化学习训练中施加自适应、敏感度感知的扰动，使大语言模型智能体的策略在面对隐藏状态噪声、剪枝和量化等扰动时保持鲁棒，同时确保优化过程的稳定性。
en_tdlr: Proposes SPrPO, a stable perturbation-robust policy optimization method that applies adaptive, sensitivity-aware perturbations during RL training, enabling LLM agent policies to remain robust to perturbations such as hidden-state noise, pruning, and quantization while maintaining stable optimization.
